release.note: API 1.1 and work RAM region 0x1000 as in rc.4, TP-209.1 fixes as in rc.5, plus TP-209.2 timing fixes: Z80 bus steal on 68k-bus access, 68000 DRAM refresh model with its audio and video rules, fill/copy DMA and FIFO entries paced by the line they run in, even-rate fill/copy DMA, YM2612 access stamps by instruction, 68k/Z80 BUSREQ arbitration, multi-line DMA reaching the frame end at the next blanking rate, progressive VRAM fill, DRAM refresh during MOVEM.L, E-clock interrupt acknowledge, VINT/HINT entry timing, 68000 sub-cycle remainder across DMA, status HBlank bit, V counter phase and VDP read stamps (no ABI change). v0.2.0-rc.1 failed in CI before packaging and has no release.
